prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” agency for everyone — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget and timeline. Tell me a few quick details and I’ll recommend the best matches. Useful details to share:
- Primary goal: brand awareness, lead generation, user acquisition, SEO, paid ads, content, e‑commerce growth, or full digital transformation?
- Industry: B2B SaaS, consumer products, fintech, healthcare, retail, etc.
- Monthly budget range (roughly)
- Company stage: startup, scale‑up, enterprise
- Any must‑have capabilities: Shopify/BigCommerce, HubSpot/Marketo, Google Ads/Facebook, analytics/BI, creative/video, CRO

How I pick agencies (what I’ll check for):
- Relevant case studies and measurable results in your vertical
- Track record with similar budgets and company stage
- Client references and retention
- Specialized skills (SEO, paid media, e‑commerce, creative)
- Reporting transparency and KPIs
- Pricing model and contract flexibility

If you want a quick starter: tell me the four details above and I’ll return a curated shortlist of 4–6 highly rated San Francisco digital agencies (with what they’re best at and why).
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
